title: Analysis of Kimsuky malware disguised as a National Tax Service refund notice
content_md:
Today we will analyze 국세환급금지급통지서.lnk, malware created by the North Korean hacking group Kimsuky. The malware impersonates a National Tax Service refund payment notice.

File name: 국세환급금지급통지서.lnk
MD5: caddfeeaa1c68aff34cfd1fc6e1e214..
Article link: https://malware.news/t/kimsuky-lnk/127686#post_1
exclude_reason: Short Korean sample notice with no complete hash or substantive chain detail; it adds little beyond existing Kimsuky LNK lure coverage.
